name: GlzDialog
semanticRole: Present a short modal decision or focused task with explicit hierarchy, deterministic focus containment, and proportionate confirmation behavior.

material.rule: Dialogs use Solid Glaze or highly opaque Thick Glaze as stakes rise. Destructive or security-relevant decisions favor solidity and explicit language.

input.keyboard: Tab and Shift+Tab remain within the modal, Enter may invoke an unambiguous default action, and Escape cancels only when cancellation is safe.
input.focus: Initial focus follows task semantics; focus remains contained while modal and returns to the invoker after close.
input.hover: Hover is decorative only and no dialog action depends on it.
input.press: Press feedback is immediate and destructive confirmation requires an explicit labeled action.

accessibility.role: Use modal dialog or alertdialog semantics according to urgency and associate title and description.
accessibility.name: Every dialog has a programmatic title and icon-only close controls have explicit names.
accessibility.state: Expose modal, busy, error, success, disabled, and destructive context without color-only meaning.
accessibility.value: Nested controls expose their values; the dialog container has no synthetic value.
accessibility.keyboard: Support focus containment, Shift+Tab, safe Escape cancellation, and deterministic default-action behavior.
accessibility.focus: Initial focus is deliberate, remains visible, and invoking focus is restored on close.
accessibility.errorAssociation: Validation and command errors remain visible, associated, and announced without unexpected closure.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Use direct modal state changes or short crossfades.
accessibility.increasedContrast: Strengthen dialog boundary, focus, and action hierarchy.
accessibility.forcedColors: Use system Canvas, CanvasText, ButtonText, Highlight, and focus colors.
accessibility.largeText: Reflow at 200% text; actions may stack and the body may scroll without losing title or consequences.

fallbacks.reducedMotion: Use direct state changes or short crossfades.
fallbacks.highContrast: Strengthen boundary, focus, and action hierarchy.
fallbacks.forcedColors: Use system colors and remove blur and decorative shadow.
fallbacks.performance: Remove blur and decorative effects before altering modality, focus containment, or action geometry.

content.overflow: Short focused content may scroll internally; action labels stack before truncation and the dialog never exceeds the viewport.
content.localization: Titles, explanatory copy, and action labels tolerate 30–50% expansion without obscuring consequences.
content.rtl: Action order follows platform convention and logical alignment mirrors while destructive meaning does not.

criteria: Decision hierarchy is unmistakable without oversized decoration.
Higher-stakes dialogs become more solid and explicit rather than more translucent.
Primary, secondary, and destructive actions remain distinguishable at large text and high contrast.
